text: 近期，受今年第10号台风“美莎克”影响，广西多地发生严重暴雨、洪涝灾害。国家发展改革委在7月6日紧急安排中央预算内投资1亿元基础上，追加安排1亿元，支持广西进一步做好灾区灾后应急恢复，推动尽快恢复正常生产生活秩序。
text_en: Recently, due to Typhoon Maysak (No. 10), severe rainstorms and floods have hit multiple areas in Guangxi. The National Development and Reform Commission, after urgently allocating 100 million yuan in central budget investment on July 6, added another 100 million yuan to support Guangxi in post-disaster recovery and restoring normal production and life order.
